svg.title: Fourier sawtooth approximation and a jump
svg.desc: Fourier partial sums of the periodic sawtooth x on negative pi to pi. The left panel compares one, five, and twenty-five terms on a full period; the right compares five, twenty-five, and one hundred terms near the jump at pi. The target is drawn as separate branches, with value zero at the jump. Overshoot persists while the oscillations crowd closer to the jump.

g.text: Dashed black: the sawtooth. At each jump its assigned value is 0.
